name: Microgrid active-power ramp limiter
summary: Constrains the rate of change of the assigned dispatch target according to its configured limits.
description: Constrains the rate of change of the assigned dispatch target according to its configured limits. Active-power dispatch allocates the electrical work performed by the microgrid resources. A total site target, a resource power limit and the actual measured contribution are different quantities that must be connected clearly in the diagram.

In a microgrid with solar generation, a battery and generators, the controller can allocate an import/export target among the available resources while reserving the power needed for operating disturbances. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Requested power target” at the input and “Rate-limited target” at the output. Actual resource response can differ from the target.
